english: All the letters of the word RESIST are arranged at random, all the distinct arrangements being equally likely, and the arrangement obtained is regarded as a word $W$. Let $p$ be the probability that, in dictionary order, $W$ comes after the word RESIST and before the word SISTER. Then the value of $\dfrac{1}{p}$ is ______.
hindi: शब्द RESIST के सभी अक्षरों को यादृच्छया व्यवस्थित किया जाता है, सभी भिन्न व्यवस्थाएँ समसम्भाव्य हैं, तथा प्राप्त व्यवस्था को एक शब्द $W$ माना जाता है। माना कि $p$ इसकी प्रायिकता है कि शब्दकोश क्रम में $W$ शब्द RESIST के बाद तथा शब्द SISTER से पहले आता है। तब $\dfrac{1}{p}$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Letters $E,I,R,S,S,T$: $\dfrac{6!}{2!}=360$ words. Both RESIST and SISTER are such words

Rank of RESIST: words starting $E$: $\dfrac{5!}{2!}=60$, starting $I$: $60$; then $RE$: before $SIST$ come $REI\dots$: $\dfrac{3!}{2!}=3$; then RESIST is the first $RES\dots$ word. Rank $=60+60+3+1=124$
Rank of SISTER: starting $E,I,R$: $3\cdot60=180$; $SE$: $4!=24$; $SIE$: $3!=6$; $SIR$: $6$; $SIS$: before $TER$ come $E\dots$: $2$, $R\dots$: $2$; then SISTER. Rank $=180+24+6+6+4+1=221$
solution_full: Sample space: the letters $E,I,R,S,S,T$ (with $S$ twice) give $\dfrac{6!}{2!}=360$ distinct words, all equally likely. RESIST and SISTER are two of them, so $p=\dfrac{r_{2}-r_{1}-1}{360}$, where $r_{1}$, $r_{2}$ are their ranks in dictionary order.

Rank of RESIST. Words beginning with $E$: the other letters $I,R,S,S,T$ give $\dfrac{5!}{2!}=60$. Beginning with $I$: also $60$. Beginning with $R$: second letter $E$ is the smallest, so we continue with $RE$ and the letters $I,S,S,T$. Words $REI\dots$: $\dfrac{3!}{2!}=3$. Then $RES$ with $I,S,T$ left: the first such word is $RESIST$ itself. So $r_{1}=60+60+3+1=124$.

Rank of SISTER. Words beginning with $E$, $I$, $R$: $60$ each, total $180$. Beginning with $S$ (letters $E,I,R,S,T$ left, all distinct): $SE\dots$: $4!=24$. Then $SI$ with $E,R,S,T$ left: $SIE\dots$: $3!=6$, $SIR\dots$: $6$. Then $SIS$ with $E,R,T$ left: $SISE\dots$: $2$, $SISR\dots$: $2$; then $SIST$ with $E,R$: $SISTER$ is the first. So $r_{2}=180+24+6+6+2+2+1=221$.
Number of words strictly between: $221-124-1=96$. Hence $p=\dfrac{96}{360}=\dfrac{4}{15}$.
originality_note: New: two anagrams with a repeated letter (RESIST and SISTER) bound a dictionary interval, and the probability that a random arrangement falls inside it needs both ranks (way 5: rank of a word linked with a probability over alike-letter arrangements). Closest known: 'rank of the word SURITI / MOTHER in dictionary order'. Different because: two ranks with a repeated letter are needed and the answer is the size of the gap between them.
